_about: SCRIPTED demo replay (not a real recording), written from the approved scripts and items; every agent line is the backend's `say` for that step. Voices are synthesized with ElevenLabs text-to-speech by agent/synthesize_scenario.py, which also re-times the events to the audio. Format: docs/04-voice-agent.md § Replay format. checkin_id is injected by the replay engine. Expected outcome: no red flag and no page; NAUSEA_FREQ often and FATIGUE_SEV mild go to review. Shows the extra-time agent: slower speech, a slow word-for-word repeat when asked, and every rated answer read back before it is recorded.
title: Walter, English, extra time, hard of hearing, nausea

body.verbatim_quote: Often, I'd say. Most mornings, after breakfast.
No. My son would've told me.

transcript.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with Walter?
Hello? Yes... this is Walter.
Thank you. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Sorry, could you say that again? My hearing isn't so good.
Let me ask that again. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Oh, sure. Go ahead.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Rarely.
I understood: rarely. Is that right?
That's right.
In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Hmm. Often, I'd say. Most mornings, after breakfast.
I understood: often, most mornings after breakfast. Is that right?
Yes.
In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never. I haven't thrown up.
I understood: never. Is that right?
Right.
In the past 7 days, have you had a fever, chills, or shaking?
No.
In the past 7 days, how much shortness of breath have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None.
In the past 7 days, how much dizziness have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
None. No dizziness.
In the past 7 days, how much tiredness or lack of energy have you had? Would you say none, mild, moderate, severe, or very severe?
A little tired. Mild.
I understood: mild. Is that right?
Yes, mild.
Does resting make the tiredness better?
Yes. A nap helps.
In the past 7 days, have you had a new skin rash?
No.
Have you or your family noticed any new confusion, trouble finding words, or unusual sleepiness?
No. My son would've told me.
Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
No. Same pills as always.
Since your last study visit, have you gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No.
Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, that's all. Thank you.
Thank you, Walter. The research team will review your answers. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.

summary_en: Scripted demo: Walter (hard of hearing) asked for the consent question to be repeated. He reports nausea often, most mornings after breakfast, no vomiting, and mild tiredness that a nap helps. No red flags; no page.
